Basic meanings of word: (transitive) to reveal, (reflexive) to prove to be/ transpire
to shoe, to put on footwear
(reflexive) to seize/ get hold of (+ de)
to cross (a line), to pass (an obstacle), to cover (a distance)
to ice skate, (motorsport) to spin wheels without going anywhere
to plant, to drive in (a nail), (reflexive, slang) to fail
